excerpt: CDF is one of two detectors positioned along the four-mile Tevatron accelerator ring. ... The 4,500-ton detector sits more than four stories tall. ... Physicists observed the first proton-antiproton collisions produced by the Tevatron on Oct. 13, 1985. ... On March 2, 1995, physicists at CDF and DZero announced the discovery of the top quark.
